title: Isolate generator main 52-GM of path A for maintenance (rack out, stored energy, lockout)
summary: Path A is on utility, 52-GM is open and the generator bus is in standby. Maintenance needs 52-GM out of its cell. At the 13.8 kV switchgear (field view): take local control, rack 52-GM to TEST, switch its spring-charging motor OFF and release the stored energy (close and open it in TEST), rack it to DISCONNECTED and apply your personal padlock to the racking mechanism. 52-U carries path A the whole time: touching it ends the drill. Switching the procedure does not call for counts as a violation.
references: OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147(d): application of control, including release of stored energy after isolation (paragraph numbers quoted from memory: verify)
OSHA 29 CFR 1910.147(e)(3): each lockout device is removed by the employee who applied it (verify)
NFPA 70E Article 120: establishing an electrically safe work condition (edition-specific numbering: verify)

steps.text: Take local control: MV transfer A authority to LOCAL (remote and automatic close blocked)
Rack 52-GM from CONNECTED to TEST (field view, racking crank)
Release the stored energy: close and open 52-GM in TEST until the spring reads DISCHARGED
Apply your personal padlock to the 52-GM racking mechanism

fail.reason: 52-U opened: wrong breaker, the utility incomer carries path A (load on battery)
86 of 52-U tripped: wrong breaker, path A lost its incomer
